field.label: Reporter enabled
field.help: Submit local firewall block events to AbuseIPDB. Requires a rule label to mark reportable events.

field.label: Minimum hits before report
field.help: Number of block events from an IP before it is reported. Reduces false positives.

field.label: Rate limit per IP (min)
field.help: Minimum minutes between two reports for the same IP.

field.label: Daily report quota
field.help: Maximum number of reports submitted per day. Free-tier allows 1000.

field.label: Default categories
field.help: Comma-separated AbuseIPDB category IDs used when a rule has no specific mapping. 14=PortScan, 15=Hacking, 18=BruteForce, 22=SSH.
